overall_assessment: Reviewed all eight random-control plans in full and all three failed entries. The plans have readable sections and course metadata, but four of eight retain bare PDF page numbers despite zero pre-pass flags; no further defect is established from the packet, which lacks source-page comparisons. The PEL2.1/PEL1.4 discrepancy is explicitly accounted for by the pipeline alias mapping, current-plan configuration makes historical-year mismatches inapplicable, and the three failed entries have plausible URLs also used by successful examples.

findings.description: Bare PDF page numbers interrupt learning outcomes, content and assessment or remain at the end of the extracted plan. This affects both mathematics plans and both natural-science plans (4/8 text-bearing controls), violating the requirement to exclude page numbers; the junk pre-pass did not flag them. The later anonymizer already removes these numbers, but the audited extracted_text still contains them.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/harvest_strategies.R::.steiner_extract_emner_from_pdf() removes the labelled form Side N av M but leaves bare numeric PDF footer lines. The corresponding bare-number cleanup currently occurs only in R/anonymize.R::.anon_steiner().
findings.suggested_fix: Remove numeric footer lines from each PDF page before concatenation in .steiner_extract_emner_from_pdf(), restricting removal to the final nonempty line of a page and verifying sequential page numbering. Preserve numeric facts-box values such as the standalone credit value 10 or 15; do not apply the anonymizer numeric-line regex indiscriminately to fulltext.
